decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate is a flagship built on the firm's core agricultural crate and injection-moulding know-how, so the firm can keep learning from harvest feedback and refine it in-house.
Stackable crates sit at the centre of the firm's knowledge base and serve food and retail customers, so they are easy to improve and there is little reason to withdraw them.
The medium-duty rackable pallet extends established pallet engineering, its results are easy to interpret, and it fits ongoing pooling and industrial demand.
The spill-retention pallet is a niche safety product, but it builds on related pallet moulding know-how, so the firm keeps it while its narrower demand is assessed.

The pallet with load retainers is a modest variant of existing pallets that the firm can adjust through its own engineering at low cost, though as a single model it is somewhat more exposed to consolidation.
